title: Deployment-wide reads gate on the home org, not on any signed-in session
deviations_from_card: (1) Added GET /api/llm/config (as the coordinator asked): its r02 `health` block aggregates llm_usage, so it is OMITTED for a non-home-org session; the pins stay on requireOperator (the panel treats absent health as 'no chip'). (2) Updated app/api/llm/usage/usage-route-contract.test.ts, a source guard that pinned `await requireOperator()`: it now pins requireHomeOrgReader and forbids the old gate. (3) The llm/usage + llm/activity + llm/config behavioural cases live in deployment-read-gate.test.ts next to the ratchet. (4) HOME_ORG_ID = 'org-default' is spelled in require-operator.ts rather than imported from db/organizations.ts (which pulls db/core into ~140 importers' graphs); a test pins it equal to DEFAULT_ORG_ID. The 403 body is built inline and a test pins its `error` to REFUSAL_ERRORS.FORBIDDEN_CAPABILITY, which keeps api-response.ts out of the graph (the perf walker follows dynamic imports). (5) Ratchet also covers routingHealth.
notes: Gate exit codes are the real whole-tree results. Every failure in them is on files I did not touch; all 7 test files in my directories pass (touched_tests 0), and tsc and eslint are clean on my files. The foreign failures: tsc (devcase/[id], profile/route, PipelinePopulatedBoard, DevTabCasesView, CandidateDetailModal, and the untracked kpi-sim/ tree), lint:ts-ratchet (a new @ts-expect-error, none in my files), api:check (undocumented devcase/[id], glyphs/[id], pipeline/stage-sla), test:unit (error-response-contract on pipeline/stage-sla/route.ts:62, loading-gap-debt, candidateMatrixContracts, devcase flakes). test:perf had about 18 over-ceiling route lines before my change, all from siblings' uncommitted files (measured with my require-operator.ts swapped back to HEAD). My change adds about 1-2 KB to each graph that imports require-operator and pushes no new route over its ceiling, but it does add to lines that are already over. KNOWN GAP, not fixed (outside the write set; documented in api-contracts.md §1.2): GET /api/palette/preview reaches aggregateLlmUsage/countActiveTasks through app/_lib/palette-preview (resolveActivity; the 30-day cost in resolveModels), gated no higher than isOperator(). The source ratchet only sees direct calls in route files. Also cosmetic: AboutTab.tsx and interview-lab/page.tsx still show the /diagrams link to seats that pass isOperator, so a non-home-org seat sees a link that 404s. The per-case message for FORBIDDEN_CAPABILITY reads 'Your role does not allow this action.'
